/* cppi::514afceb2ec2f1ca9b264719f9630f8d13d2cf3e16d11e6955d632d4f277d5af */
WITH latest_meta_run_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(df_meta_run_date) AS max_run_date
    FROM df_trusted_prod.markit_credit_index_component
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
),
latest_file_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(file_date) AS max_file_date
    FROM market.markit_credit_index
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
)
SELECT
    idx.index_family,
    idx.index_name,
    idx.annex_date,
    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,
    comp.component_ref_entity_name,
    comp.component_ref_entity_red,
    comp.component_ref_entity_record_date,
    comp.component_ref_entity_type,
    comp.component_ref_entity_weight AS component_weight,
    comp.component_coupon_type,
    comp.component_currency,
    comp.component_maturity,
    comp.component_coupon,
    evt.red_entity_code,
    evt.reference_entity,
    evt.ticker,
    evt.cerrd AS event_determination_date,
    evt.corporateaction_event_date,
    evt.default_date,
    evt.type,
    evt.event_type,
    evt.auction_date,
    evt.tier_name,
    evt.auction_price,
    evt.auction_cash_settlement_date AS settlement_date
FROM df_trusted_prod.markit_credit_index_component AS comp
JOIN market.markit_credit_event_details_latest AS evt
    ON comp.component_ref_entity_red = evt.red_entity_code
JOIN market.markit_credit_index AS idx
    ON idx.index_clip = comp.index_clip
WHERE
    comp.df_meta_run_date = (SELECT max_run_date FROM latest_meta_run_date)
    AND idx.file_date = (SELECT max_file_date FROM latest_file_date)
    AND SUBSTRING(comp.index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
    AND evt.auction_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    idx.index_series ASC, idx.index_version ASC, comp.component_ref_entity_ticker ASC

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)
SELECT a.*,
    b.first_breach_date,
    c.first_alert_date,
    date_diff(
        'day',
        cast(b.first_breach_date as date),
        cast(a.business_date as date)
    ) num_of_breach_days,
    date_diff(
        'day',
        cast(c.first_alert_date as date),
        cast(a.business_date as date)
    ) num_of_alert_days
FROM "risk_prod"."limit_utilization" a
    left outer join first_breach_date b on a.limit_name = b.limit_name
    and a.limit_id = b.limit_id
    left outer join first_alert_date c on a.limit_name = c.limit_name

	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 15:13:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc

			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd

		where 
			dataset_id in (

				  'MRP_TF'

				, 'ATP_TF'

				, 'INV_SELECT_C'

				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select

			, "level"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc

			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (

	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(

			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'

			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'

		  end period

	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name

			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc

		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll

			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from

				, 'RP_TF'

				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'

				, 'MRP_C'

				, 'ATP_C'

				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'

				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'

			and "level" = 1

		union all

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency

		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly

			dataset_id in (

				, 'RP_TF'

				, 'MRP_S'

				, 'ATP_S'

				, 'INV_SELECT_S'

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll

			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (

	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		  dataset_id

		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'

			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'

	from (		
		select

			, node_name

		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (

		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (

	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(

			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		  dataset_id

		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'

			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'

	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id

			, node_name

		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc

	cross join unnest(

			  time_weighted_return_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

	inner join (

			, currency
			, period

		from

		group by

			, "level"
			, currency

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)

			, case

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end

					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'

					, 'IPN_S'

	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'

			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx'

			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc

			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd

			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd

		  ]

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
